description: This file defines the EmployeeEventDao class, which manages data access operations related to employee events in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving employee events and retrieving them with optional filtering based on parameters such as date range, employee number, event, and type.

classes.name: EmployeeEventDao
classes.description: Data access object for handling operations related to EmployeeEvent entities, including saving and retrieving events with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Persists a new EmployeeEvent entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of EmployeeEvent entities filtered by the specified search parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Paginator object for EmployeeEvent entities based on search filters such as date range, employee number, event, and type.
